title: Home, garden and furniture: IKEA buyback, cleaning and repair, assembly, tenure, planning, garden, lighting, room sizes
method: WebSearch and WebFetch. confirmed=true only where the figure was read on the publisher's own page or PDF. Search-engine excerpts, aggregators, cost guides and press are confirmed=false. Several publisher pages (homedepot.com, argos.co.uk, checkatrade.com, angi.com, homeguide.com, lendershandbook.ukfinance.org.uk, carpet-clean.ie) returned HTTP 403 to the fetcher, so figures from them are excerpts and marked false.

ikeaBuyback.note: Top priority. Every market pays in IKEA store credit (refund card), never cash. Only the UK and Ireland publish percentage tiers on IKEA's own pages; the US and Canada publish none (assessment by 'condition, age and functionality'). No IKEA Mexico buyback page was found.

figures.value: In-store credit at participating stores only, 'No other form of payment'; IKEA Family account required; quote 'based on the condition of the product and the product's original retail value'; allow 5 business days for assessment; all Canadian stores participate except Design Studios and Pick-up locations. figures.value: Accepted: bookcases, shelf units, chests of drawers, nightstands, non-kitchen cabinets, non-fabric chairs/stools, dining tables, office desks/chairs, multimedia furniture, small tables, decor/storage (not lighting or cookware). Excluded: sofas, armchairs, mattresses, bed frames, outdoor, kitchens, PAX wardrobes, glass items, items more than 10 years past end-of-sale date, items missing the original IKEA sticker.
